SpellDataModificationEntry.note: CIP RE: wrapper repeated @ +0x18; classic u16 spellId + u8 mod + u8 value

ProtocolInventoryItem.note: RE from tip classic ProtocolGame::getInventorySlot — not invented CIP ProtocolObject names. Reusable for container/tile item opcodes later.

GraphicalEffectEntry.note: CIP TProtobufServerMessageTranslator::v29 entries: kind 0 graphical (coordinate, id, delay, source), 1 missile (coordinate→destination, id, source), 2 main sound (coordinate, source, id), 3 secondary sound (coordinate, enum, source, id). Coordinates are absolute (deltas applied).

ProtocolCreature.note: CIP v19: kind 0x61 new (remove id, id, type, master for own summons, name), 0x62 known (id), 0x63 turn (id, direction, unpassable). Fields 24-31 are product server features (not in CIP).
